undefined : data.foundedYear, industryId: data.industryId === "" ? undefined : data.industryId, provinceId: data.provinceId === "" ? undefined : data.provinceId, districtId: data.districtId === "" ? undefined : data.districtId, } as any; updateCompany(cleanedData); }; return (
